morphology.pattern_note: ter- 表示承受痛苦后的状态，并非表示“不小心折磨”。词根中的 é 读 /e/；依所给词典读音，音节末 k 实现为喉塞音 /ʔ/。

senses.zh_definition: 遭受或处于折磨、痛楚、困苦之中；既可指身体受苦，也可指精神煎熬。
senses.en_definition: To suffer physical pain, hardship, or mental anguish; to be tormented.
senses.ms_definition: (Telah) mengalami seksa, kesengsaraan atau kesakitan; telah diseksa.
senses.nuances: 语义强于一般的不舒服；不必存在施虐者，疾病、生活困境或情绪也能使人 terseksa。口语可夸张表达难受，但不宜因此淡化他人的严重痛苦。词典义参见 [DBP PRPM：seksa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=seksa)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Laporan itu menyatakan bahawa mangsa masih terseksa akibat penderaan yang dialaminya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 报告指出，受害者仍因先前遭受的虐待而备受折磨。
dual_scenarios.en: The report states that the victim continues to suffer as a result of the abuse they experienced.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku dah dua malam tak boleh tidur, terseksa betul sebab sakit gigi ni.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya sudah dua malam tidak dapat tidur dan benar-benar terseksa kerana sakit gigi ini.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我都两晚睡不着了，这牙疼真折磨人。
dual_scenarios.en: I haven't been able to sleep for two nights. This toothache is really tormenting me.
spoken_features: dah 对应 sudah，tak 对应 tidak。
terseksa betul 用后置的 betul 加强感受。

messages.en: I haven't been able to sleep for two nights. This toothache is really tormenting me.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kesian kau. Dah buat janji temu dengan doktor gigi ke?
messages.ms_standard: Saya bersimpati dengan awak. Adakah awak sudah membuat janji temu dengan doktor gigi?
messages.zh: 你也太难受了。已经预约牙医了吗？
messages.en: That sounds awful. Have you booked a dentist's appointment?

etymology.historical_story: Seksa belongs to Malay’s Sanskrit-derived vocabulary and is associated with śikṣā, a word connected with instruction, discipline, and chastisement. Crawfurd’s 1852 dictionary already records seksa as punishment or chastisement. In modern terseksa, attention falls on the sufferer’s condition, which can include emotional anguish as well as inflicted pain. See [Crawfurd’s dictionary](https://wallace-online.org/converted/pdf/1852_Crawfurd_WS5.2.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: seksa 是“折磨”，terseksa 是“身在折磨中”；把 ter- 记成结果状态，避免误解成“无意中折磨别人”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 向他人描述痛苦时可以直接使用；回应别人时，Saya bersimpati 或 Semoga dipermudahkan 比轻率地说“忍一忍就好”更体贴。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于身体疼痛、精神煎熬及困苦处境。在虐待、战争或创伤语境中应认真使用，不拿受害者的痛苦开玩笑。
